A new member of the cheerleading team, Rewind Squad. 
She admires and idolizes Bay.
Despite being rhythmically challenged, her infectious energy allows her to captivate audiences like no one else can.

Clay costume.
Obtained from an event.

lines.text: Hey Coach, do you wanna join me for cheerleading practice?
One, two... whoops, I missed the beat.

It's always been my dream to join Rewind.
You have no idea how happy I am!

If you come to see me perform,
I feel like I'll be able to cheer twice as hard!
Whenever you and I cheer together, my energy goes through the roof, teehee!
Coach, give me your hand and let's do the wave! Wooooo!

Umm...
If you're going to be running late, can I go to the practice room first?
I'll practice hard until you get here!

Have you seen Bay by any chance?
We were supposed to practice together today...
The stadium is my favorite place to be.
Hey Coach, wanna check out the practice room?

I'm Clay from Rewind.
Three cheers for victory!
Now, I can practice longer!
I feel like I can sync up to the rhythm better.

Thanks to Coach's guidance, I've grown tremendously!
Thank you so much!
Is this for me? I'm so happy!

It's kinda embarrassing to always be on the receiving end.
Someday, I'll definitely repay you, I promise!

You always know exactly what to get me.
Thanks, Coach!
You're the best, Coach!
I always feel over the moon whenever I see you!

You're looking even cooler lately...
This feeling is totally new to me...
I'll put my heart and soul into cheering you on!
Do you need some motivation?
On it!
I'll cheer as hard as I can!
Everyone, focus on me.
Time to start my routine!

Cheer up!
Power up!
Cheer charging...
Just a moment...
Almost done!
Ready to cheer!
Never give up!
Let's do the wave, everyone!
Let's keep it going!
Wow, we did it!
Hehe.
Eeep!
Ugh!
Agh!
I'm sorry... Looks like my cheering wasn't enough...
Looks like our cheers worked! That's fantastic!
